name: impact-reg
summary: Registers a moving volume to a fixed volume (NIfTI or OME-Zarr, e.g. microscopy) with impact-reg-konfai using FireANTs SyN, ConvexAdam or elastix presets, on GPU or CPU, and outputs the displacement field and moved image.
description: Wraps the impact-reg-konfai CLI (IMPACT multimodal registration): the engine selects a preset from the VBoussot/ImpactReg Hugging Face repository (FireANTs_SyN rigid+affine+SyN, ConvexAdam_Composite with MIND features, or elastix Generic_Rigid_BSpline), or preset_override names any other preset. Optional fixed and moving masks restrict the similarity metric. Use it for pairwise, possibly multimodal, registration of large volumes; give exactly one format (NIfTI or OME-Zarr) per volume. Presets are downloaded at run time, so the compute node needs internet access.

inputs.description: Fixed/reference volume as NIfTI (alternative to fixed_ome_zarr).
Fixed/reference volume as an OME-Zarr store (alternative to fixed_nifti).
Moving volume as NIfTI (alternative to moving_ome_zarr).
Moving volume as an OME-Zarr store (alternative to moving_nifti).
Optional fixed-space mask restricting the metric region, as NIfTI (alternative to fixed_mask_ome_zarr). Whole-image mask used if none given.
Optional fixed-space mask as an OME-Zarr store (alternative to fixed_mask_nifti).
Optional moving-space mask, as NIfTI (alternative to moving_mask_ome_zarr). Whole-image mask used if none given.
Optional moving-space mask as an OME-Zarr store (alternative to moving_mask_nifti).

outputs.description: Displacement field (moving -> fixed) as a NIfTI vector image, plus the moved image and the raw ITK Transform.h5 as extra files.

parameters.description: Registration engine/preset: fireants (FireANTs_SyN, GPU-capable diffeomorphic SyN), convexadam (ConvexAdam_Composite, MIND features), or elastix (Generic_Rigid_BSpline).
Exact preset app name from the VBoussot/ImpactReg Hugging Face repo (e.g. FireANTs_Affine, ConvexAdam_Coarse, MR_CT_TS), overriding the engine mapping. Empty uses the engine's default preset.
Use a GPU if one is visible to torch. Disable to force CPU even when a GPU is present.
Fail instead of silently falling back to CPU when no GPU is visible.
Write the displacement field only; skip computing the moved image.
Comma-separated NAME=VALUE pairs, each forwarded as a separate --set to impact-reg-konfai (e.g. to tune iterations or patch size). Empty means none.

failure_modes.fix: Check the log for the impact-reg-konfai error; with require_cuda set, make sure a GPU is available.
